title: In distress
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said at times of distress
arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: Laa ilaha illallaahul-'azeemul-haleem, laa ilaha illallaahu rabbul-'arshil-'azeem, laa ilaha illallaahu rabbus-samaawaati warabbul-ardi warabbul-'arshil-kareem
translation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the noble Throne.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6346: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9517

provenance.note: The printed al-Sultaniyya text on Shamela writes السماوات with its long alif; hadith-api writes السموات. The words are the same; we follow the printed edition.
